title: Contract Clause Risk Categories
description: Definitions for the 12 standard contract clause categories with risk indicators

categories.name: Payment Terms
categories.description: Amounts, payment schedules, milestones, late fees, invoicing requirements, and currency specifications.

categories.name: Delivery/Performance
categories.description: Scope of work, delivery timeline, acceptance criteria, milestones, and performance standards.

categories.name: Breach & Penalties
categories.description: Liquidated damages, remedies, cure periods, and consequences of breach.

categories.name: Confidentiality
categories.description: Scope of confidential information, duration, exclusions, return/destruction obligations.

categories.name: Intellectual Property
categories.description: IP ownership, licensing, work-for-hire, background IP, and assignment terms.

categories.name: Non-Compete / Non-Solicit
categories.description: Non-competition scope, duration, geographic limits, and non-solicitation restrictions.

categories.name: Jurisdiction & Dispute Resolution
categories.description: Governing law, venue, arbitration clauses, and dispute resolution procedures.

categories.name: Termination
categories.description: Termination for cause, convenience, notice periods, and effects of termination.
risk_indicators: no cause termination with short notice

categories.name: Force Majeure
categories.description: Definition of force majeure events, notice obligations, and consequences.
risk_indicators: overly broad definition includes market conditions
no termination right on prolonged force majeure

categories.name: Liability & Indemnity Caps
categories.description: Total liability caps, damages exclusions, indemnification scope, and limitations.

categories.name: Acceptance Criteria
categories.description: Testing procedures, UAT, defect classification, remediation timelines, and sign-off process.

categories.name: Renewal & Term
categories.description: Initial term, auto-renewal provisions, notice periods, and term adjustments.
